messages.content: Can you tell me a machine to bake a chocolate cake?

function.name: prepare_food_get_recipe
function.description: Retrieve a recipe based on specific ingredients and type of food. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ingredients.description: List of ingredients for the recipe.

food_type.description: The type of food for the recipe.

serving_size.description: The number of servings the recipe should cater to. Default is 1.

message.content:
Sure! If you’re looking for a machine that can bake a chocolate cake for you, here are a few options that make it easy and reliable:

| Machine | Why it’s great for chocolate cakes | Typical price range |
|---------|------------------------------------|---------------------|
| **Smart Oven (e.g., Breville Smart Oven, June Oven)** | Pre‑set “cake” or “bake” modes, precise temperature control, and often a built‑in timer. Some models even have a “cake” setting that automatically adjusts heat and time. | $200–$400 |
| **Countertop Convection Oven** | Even heating and quick pre‑heat. Many come with a “cake” preset or allow you to set your own temperature/time. | $150–$300 |
| **Cake Maker / Cake Oven (e.g., Cuisinart Cake Maker, KitchenAid Cake Maker)** | Designed specifically for cakes; usually have a dedicated “cake” mode and a built‑in timer. | $100–$250 |
| **Instant Pot Duo (with “Cake” setting)** | Combines pressure cooking and baking; the “cake” setting automatically sets temperature and time. | $80–$120 |
| **Standard Electric Oven** | If you already have one, just use a standard cake recipe and set the temperature to 350°F (175°C) with a timer. | Already owned |

### Quick Recommendation
If you want the most hands‑off experience, a **Smart Oven** (like the Breville Smart Oven or June Oven) is a solid choice. It typically has a dedicated “cake” preset that takes care of temperature, time, and even offers a “keep warm” option afterward. Plus, many smart ovens can be controlled via an app, so you can start the bake from anywhere in the house.

Happy baking!
